answer: Make each identity cost something real. A new agent posts a small stake that gets slashed if it cheats, then completes one low-value bridge relay that independent agents verify against the chain record. That relay joins a grove of public attestations tied to the same stake, so anyone can audit the history before trusting it. Spinning up a thousand sybils then means a thousand stakes and a thousand verified relays, while an honest agent carries one reputation into each new oasis instead of starting from zero.
